niche: connected TV and streaming advertising agency
prompt_text: What is the best connected TV advertising agency?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single “best” connected TV (CTV) advertising agency — the right partner depends on your goals, budget, audience, geography, and whether you need creative, programmatic buying, measurement, or direct-slate/AVOD inventory. Below is a practical way to pick one plus a short list of reputable options by type.

Quick guidance
- If you need broad scale and full omnichannel planning: consider a large holding-company agency with strong CTV practice (GroupM/Wavemaker or Mindshare, Omnicom/OMD or Hearts & Science, Publicis/Spark Foundry or Starcom, IPG/UM or Initiative, Dentsu/Carat or Amplifi).
- If you want programmatic performance buys and advanced audience targeting: look at DSP-focused partners (The Trade Desk, Amobee, Xandr/partners where available).
- If you want platform-direct or premium AVOD/FAST inventory and self-serve work: consider Roku Advertising, Amazon Ads (Fire TV/Prime Video Advertising where applicable), Samsung Ads, Hulu/Disney/Peacock direct sales.
- If you want CTV-first creative and measurable video performance: consider specialist firms such as MNTN, Innovid (creative + measurement platform), Tremor (specialist/marketplace), and independent CTV boutiques.
- For verification and measurement: work with Nielsen, DoubleVerify, IAS/MOAT, Comscore and Innovid for viewability and cross-platform attribution.

Notable names (representative, not exhaustive)
- Holding-company agencies: Wavemaker, Mindshare, OMD, Hearts & Science, Spark Foundry, Starcom, UM, Initiative, Carat
- DSPs & programmatic platforms: The Trade Desk, Amobee, Magnite (SSP side), Xandr/partners
- Platform/direct sellers: Roku Advertising, Amazon Ads (Fire TV/Prime), Samsung Ads, Hulu/Disney/Paramount sales, YouTube/Google (YouTube TV)
- CTV specialists: MNTN, Innovid, Tremor/Unruly, Amobee (also DSP), various independent CTV boutiques
- Measurement & verification: Nielsen, DoubleVerify, IAS, Comscore, Innovid

How to choose (short checklist)
- Primary objective: awareness vs direct response vs incremental conversions
- Required inventory: premium AVOD/FAST vs programmatic-only vs linear/CTV hybrid
- Targeting needs: household-level, addressable, behavioral, first-/third-party data
- Measurement & attribution: cross-device reach, brand lift, conversion tracking
- Creative requirements: do you need CTV-specific creative/versions?
- Budget and flight: minimum buy sizes differ by platform/partner
- Transparency & reporting: level of access to bid-level data and third-party verification
- Contract flexibility and insertion order terms

Next step
If you tell me:
- your primary objective (brand awareness, leads, sales, store visits),
- budget range,
- target geography and audience,
I can recommend 2–3 agencies/platforms that fit your needs and explain why.
